tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (off-white). Behind cards, the form and the gallery. In dark: the near-black ground of map, add-sticker and stats.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, side panel, header bar, tab bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, skeletons, photo placeholders, table header, pressed rows.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand surface from the original form: hint card, countdown banner, selected table rows, hero-number stickers. Text on it is ink-strong or ink only.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, hover rows, location-source badge ground. brand-ink and ink-muted are legible on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers only (decorative, below 3:1). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: input, unselected chip and secondary-button borders (≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, mint and mint-soft (≥5.4:1 in both themes). The original form's text colour.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, labels, numbers, names in 'Pegado por'. On every ground. Also the inverse fill of toasts and the '+1' badge (text on it: bg).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: 'Cargado por', dates, hints, captions. On bg, surface and mint-soft only (fails on mint: use ink there).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Papin green. Primary button and FAB fill, clusters, exact-point dot, active tab indicator, selected check badge. As text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ on bg (4.3:1); use brand-ink for smaller green text.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Green text and icons: links, active tab label, ghost buttons, selected chip label, location-source badges. On bg, surface and mint-soft (≥5.3:1). On mint only bold 19px+.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The 3px 'thickness' under primary buttons and the FAB, and their pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-deep fill: 'Mandale Mecha', cluster counts (4.5:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Tomato. Offline banner, validation dot, report flag, 'Reportado' badge fill. Text on it is on-alert, never white (white is 3.7:1).

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an alert fill (4.5:1 light, 6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: alert-ink
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid-field border, destructive ghost label, destructive button fill. On bg, surface and alert-soft (≥5.7:1).

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Error message ground, admin reason badges, 'Borrar' confirm sheet header. alert-ink reads on it.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a destructive button (alert-ink fill): 6.0:1 light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: die
tokens.usage: The die-cut sticker edge: outline of markers, type icons, avatars, polaroid frames. Stays light in dark mode, like a real sticker.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text on die, avatar and medal fills in BOTH themes (polaroid captions, initials, medal numbers).

tokens.name: avatar-1
tokens.usage: Avatar initials sticker fill (mint). Pick avatar-1…6 by a stable hash of the person's name; text on-pastel.

tokens.name: avatar-2
tokens.usage: Avatar fill (butter). Text on-pastel.

tokens.name: avatar-3
tokens.usage: Avatar fill (peach). Text on-pastel.

tokens.name: avatar-4
tokens.usage: Avatar fill (sky). Text on-pastel.

tokens.name: avatar-5
tokens.usage: Avatar fill (lilac). Text on-pastel.

tokens.name: avatar-6
tokens.usage: Avatar fill (sand). Text on-pastel.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: 1st-place medal sticker in leaderboards. Number on-pastel (9.1:1).

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: 2nd-place medal sticker. Number on-pastel (9.9:1).

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: 3rd-place medal sticker. Number on-pastel (6.0:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal sheets, the filters drawer and dialogs. Not behind a peeking spot sheet (the map stays usable).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (see shadow focus-ring). ≥11:1 on bg, surface and mint; 3.7:1 against brand in light.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: background/land. Muted so stickers pop. map-label reads on it (4.5:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: water and ocean.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: parks, grass, wood.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: road fill, all classes (no yellow/orange highways).

tokens.name: map-road-casing
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: road casing.

tokens.name: map-building
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: building footprints (z15+).

tokens.name: map-border
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: country and state boundaries.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: MapLibre style override: place and road labels (halo map-land).

tokens.name: lightbox
tokens.usage: Lightbox ground (photo/video viewer), both themes. Text on it: on-lightbox, on-lightbox-muted.

tokens.name: on-lightbox
tokens.usage: Titles, counter and icons on lightbox (19.7:1).

tokens.name: on-lightbox-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata on lightbox: 'Pegado por … · fecha' (11.8:1).

tokens.name: lightbox-control
tokens.usage: Round control fills and inactive dots on lightbox and over video. Icons on it are on-lightbox.

tokens.name: life-alive
tokens.usage: F4 'Vivo' status dot and timeline dot (text on it: on-brand). Never the only signal: the badge always says 'Vivo'.

tokens.name: life-unknown
tokens.usage: F4 'Sin noticias' ring (hollow dot, dashed marker ring). ≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: life-gone
tokens.usage: F4 'Despegado' bar glyph; gone markers are also greyscale at 50% and hidden by default.

tokens.name: route-1
tokens.usage: F5 first person's route line and stops (solid). ≥5:1 on map-land, ≥4.4:1 on map-water in both themes.

tokens.name: route-2
tokens.usage: F5 second route (dashed 9/6). Routes also differ by dash and carry the person's name: never by hue alone.

tokens.name: route-3
tokens.usage: F5 third route (dotted 2/6).

tokens.name: route-4
tokens.usage: F5 fourth route (dash-dot).

tokens.name: on-route
tokens.usage: Stop numbers on a route-1…4 fill (≥5.7:1 light, ≥8:1 dark).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque (Google Fonts, variable opsz 12–96, wght 500–800). Chunky and friendly: headings, buttons, numbers. Never for paragraphs.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero numbers on Stats and the profile; one per sticker.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, sheet titles when expanded, desktop section titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, the place name in the spot sheet, leaderboard headings.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and FAB labels, segmented options, cluster counts (with tabular figures).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name in headers, next to the potato sticker.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree (Google Fonts, wght 400–800). The legible UI face. Inputs stay at 16px so iOS does not zoom.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tocá un sticker para ver la foto.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, the 'Pegado por' line, selected options.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip labels, table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tab labels, badges, counters, polaroid meta.

styles.name: coords
styles.usage: Parsed coordinates, accuracy (±12 m), admin IDs.

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile side gutter is space-4 (16px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge offsets, chip internal gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card, between label and field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutters (mobile), card padding, floating UI inset from screen edges.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in the form, between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop section gaps, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page margins, hero breathing room.

radius.note: Soft and sticker-like. Pills for anything you tap to toggle.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small thumbnails, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toasts, photo thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, side panel, legend, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners, the phone-sized hint card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented control, FAB, avatars, markers, clusters.

shadow.note: Stickers on a wall: a tight contact shadow plus a soft drop. Combine die-outline with shadow-sticker for the die-cut look.

tokens.name: die-outline
tokens.usage: The white die-cut edge as a box-shadow ring (follows the radius). Markers, type icons, avatars, number badges.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Anything that is a sticker: markers, chips when selected, polaroids, stat stickers, cards in the form.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating over the map: header card, FAB, legend, map controls, toasts, side panel.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (upward shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: The 'thickness' under primary buttons and the FAB; drops to 0 with translateY(3px) on press.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus (:focus-visible): a 2px bg-coloured gap, then a solid 3px focus ring. Add it after any existing shadows.

tilt.note: Stickers sit slightly crooked. Pick a tilt by a stable index (spot id or list position mod 4), never Math.random() per render.

tokens.name: tilt-1
tokens.usage: Index 0: markers, polaroids, avatars, number badges.

tokens.name: tilt-2
tokens.usage: Index 1.

tokens.name: tilt-3
tokens.usage: Index 2. Also the selected type chip icon.

tokens.name: tilt-4
tokens.usage: Index 3.

tokens.name: tilt-slap
tokens.usage: Start angle of the Gracias slap animation; never at rest.

size.note: Hit targets and fixed chrome sizes.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable (pad visually smaller controls).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips in the form, secondary buttons, segmented control.

tokens.name: button-lg-h
tokens.usage: FAB and the 'Mandale Mecha' submit button.

tokens.name: appbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile top bar inside the floating header card.

tokens.name: topnav-h
tokens.usage: Desktop header.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar (plus the safe-area inset).

tokens.name: marker-head
tokens.usage: Map marker head (type icon in die-cut). Selected: 56px.

tokens.name: marker-dot
tokens.usage: Exact-point dot at the marker anchor (the real coordinate).

tokens.name: sheet-peek
tokens.usage: Spot bottom sheet in its peek state (above the tab bar).

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Desktop side panel and the filters drawer width.

tokens.name: story-w
tokens.usage: Exported IG story image width (F2 share card, F5 Wrapped). Previews scale it down with --w.

tokens.name: story-h
tokens.usage: Exported IG story image height (9:16).

tokens.name: og-w
tokens.usage: Open Graph share card width for /s/:id.

tokens.name: og-h
tokens.usage: Open Graph share card height.

tokens.name: video-max
tokens.usage: F1: max clip length in seconds after trimming (unitless number).

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Map controls, legend, attribution.

tokens.name: z-fab
tokens.usage: FAB and the sticky submit bar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet, side panel, tab bar.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Header card and desktop top nav.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Scrim, dialogs, lightbox.
